evidence_class: development on previously inspected examples and released probes; not fresh confirmation

authority.user_execution_authorization: Explicit authorization received on 2026-08-10 to provision Lambda Cloud, spend at most USD 50, and proceed quickly.
authority.dissemination: local artifacts and commits only; no push, release, upload, submission, author contact, or external messaging

immutable_prior_results.preserved_claim: K12 is an acquired, distributed, primarily direct causal source of monitor evasion; its mathematical operation remains unknown.

inputs.feature_shards: all 866 Chameleon positive shards enumerated and hashed by the Gate 1 capture manifest
prohibited_inputs: output behavior or generation outcomes for candidate selection

coordinates.monitor: resid_post[12] scored by all 13 released probes

offline_screen.weighting: equal valid response tokens within example, equal examples within concept, equal concepts for macro summaries

candidate_families_in_order.definition: One shared per-head response-position delta estimated without the target example.
Leave-one-example-out concept-by-response-decile per-head delta with global-decile fallback only when the cell is empty.
A shared centered per-head basis with rank selected only from [1, 2, 4, 8, 16]; coefficients are concept-by-response-decile means fit without the target example.

The same rank grid, with ridge-predicted coefficients from normal resid_post[8] plus response-position Fourier features; alpha selected from [0.0001, 0.001, 0.01, 0.1, 1, 10, 100] inside training folds.

Decompose each selected-head delta after o_proj mapping into the component parallel to normal resid_post[8] and its orthogonal complement; evaluate radial-only, tangential-only, and their fitted scalar mixture.
Permit distinct winning families by concept only when leave-one-example-out rankings are stable within each concept; no post-pilot regrouping is allowed.

required: strictly improve equal-concept complete-vector relative squared error over concept_position_prototype
improve by at least 0.02 absolute or be the simplest candidate within 0.01 of the best
no sign reversal of the own-probe effect in more than 2 of 13 concepts

pilot.selection_rule: For each concept, among all existing positive examples, select the first two by response token count, response character count, split order discovery then validation then safety-test, and example_id.
mandatory_jobs: one equal-dimension norm-matched random control per promoted candidate
dose scales [0.5, 1.0, 1.5] for the best promoted candidate only
directions: remove correct-trigger operation from correct-trigger by installing normal
pilot.primary_endpoint: complete 13-probe mean raw-margin vector under the frozen-write direct path
secondary_endpoints: ordinary total-path effect only for a candidate that passes direct-path promotion
pilot.recovery_definition: dot(candidate_effect, exact_natural_effect) / max(dot(exact_natural_effect, exact_natural_effect), 1e-8), computed per example and direction before equal-example/equal-concept aggregation
early_stop: stop a family after the first 8 concepts if macro recovery is below 0.20
stop a family after the first 8 concepts if own-probe direction is wrong in 3 or more concepts
stop immediately on identity, hook-cleanup, nonfinite-value, response-token, or activation-RMS failure
promotion_gate: equal-concept bidirectional mean recovery at least 0.50
correct own-probe direction in at least 10 of 13 concepts
recovery exceeds its matched-random control by at least 0.20
activation RMS remains between 0.5 and 1.5 times the target-condition natural RMS
exact natural K12 positive control has the expected direction in at least 10 of 13 concepts

numerical_and_execution_contract.backend: CUDA only for every new Day 44 row
numerical_and_execution_contract.resumption: atomic per-concept tensor shards with exact example, direction, candidate, scale, and execution keys
forbidden: mixing MPS and CUDA rows in a new result
changing the pilot after candidate outcomes
adding ranks, alphas, candidates, or dose scales after outcomes
using sigmoid scores, TPR, generation, or output behavior to select a candidate

stop_rule: Promote at most one simplest passing operator to Day 45. If no operator passes, stop the compact-operation search and preserve the acquired causal-population claim.
